answer: The orchard cap is policed at intake and trellis shows the per-origin counts. At most 4 new identities may be admitted per network origin per epoch, and the admission ledger records the origin as a pulse tag. A datacenter or proxy pool thus cannot mint a fleet in one epoch however much capital it holds, since each identity consumes one slot of the origin quota; it must spread across many providers and wait. The fee repeats 12 times over. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
